item.title: EplayerX 1.2.9
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 下载列表新增已观看标记，结合本地播放记录与 Trakt 历史显示观看状态。 - 完善已下载视频的片头片尾跳过与播放标识展示。 - 播放器截图文件名包含影片名称、剧集编号和播放时间，重复截图自动保留为新文件。
- 修复无音轨视频可能触发音频引擎异常的问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Added watched indicators to downloads using local playback records and Trakt history. - Improved intro/outro skipping and playback branding for downloaded videos. - Player screenshots now include the title, episode number, and playback position in their filenames, preserving repeated captures as separate files.
- Fixed an audio engine error that could occur when playing videos without an audio track.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
